narr: Classic summertime pattern favored the development of strong storms, with one such storm becoming severe. This caused a downburst and resulted in wind damage in Richland County. Strong moisture convergence and high precipitable water several hours later caused training thunderstorms over downtown Columbia leading to flash flooding.
ev: USGS camera at the intersection of Whaley and Main streets showed a car trapped and partially submerged in flood waters on Whaley Street with rescue ongoing at 1:29 am local. The gage reached the flood stage of 7.2 feet near 12:57 am local and crested at 10.76 feet at 1:27 am local. The stream returned within its banks around 155 am local. Survey of the area this morning shows flooding occurred in Maxcy Gregg Park, the parking area at Sumter and Catawba Streets and also the parking lot along Main Street just NNW of the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street.
